newsitem.title: CANADA: TVI says Echo not to match BHP deal.
newsitem.headline: TVI says Echo not to match BHP deal.

text.p: TVI Pacific Inc said that Echo Bay Mines Ltd has elected not to match an agreement in principle between TVI and BHP Minerals International Exploration Inc on certain Philippine prospects.

TVI said the deal between TVI and BHP entitles BHP to earn a 51 percent equity interest in each of the application areas for expenditures of US$2.5 million on North Sierra Madre and US$2.0 million on South Sierra Madre application areas in Luzon in the northern Philippines.
BHP and TVI will contribute to further evaluation and pre-feasibility expenditures on a pro-rata basis.

During the term of the agreement, BHP will be the operator of the project and will conduct the exploration program for these areas. TVI will supply personnel and support to these programs as requested by BHP.
BHP is a unit of Australia's Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd.
